\section[(dialogue)]{Things, nature and animals — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R84-first-pass-things-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the police and a library.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bottle, a pen, paper, a notebook, a pencil
  \item a bag, a phone, an umbrella, money, a present
  \item a watch, glasses, a box, a suitcase, a ticket
  \item a tree, a flower, a leaf, a mountain, a wood
  \item a river, a lake, the sea, a stone, sand
  \item a beach, an island, a field, the sun, the moon
  \item a star, a cloud, rain, the wind, fire
  \item a dog, a cat, a horse, a cow, a pig
  \item a bird, a mouse, a wolf, a bear, a fox
  \item a snake, a hen, a duck, a sheep, a goat
  \item a lion, a monkey, a bee, an ant, an elephant
  \item big, small, new, old, beautiful
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bottle? (\textbf{la bottiglia}.) A pen? (\textbf{la penna}.) Paper? (\textbf{la carta}.) A notebook? (\textbf{il quaderno}.) A pencil? (\textbf{la matita}.) A bag? (\textbf{la borsa}.) A phone? (\textbf{il telefono}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{l'ombrello}.) Money? (\textbf{i soldi}.) A present? (\textbf{il regalo}.) A watch? (\textbf{l'orologio}.) Glasses? (\textbf{gli occhiali}.) A box? (\textbf{la scatola}.) A suitcase? (\textbf{la valigia}.) A ticket? (\textbf{il biglietto}.) A tree? (\textbf{l'albero}.) A flower? (\textbf{il fiore}.) A leaf? (\textbf{la foglia}.) A mountain? (\textbf{la montagna}.) A wood? (\textbf{il bosco}.) A river? (\textbf{il fiume}.) A lake? (\textbf{il lago}.) The sea? (\textbf{il mare}.) A stone? (\textbf{la pietra}.) Sand? (\textbf{la sabbia}.) A beach? (\textbf{la spiaggia}.) An island? (\textbf{l'isola}.) A field? (\textbf{il campo}.) The sun? (\textbf{il sole}.) The moon? (\textbf{la luna}.) A star? (\textbf{la stella}.) A cloud? (\textbf{la nuvola}.) Rain? (\textbf{la pioggia}.) The wind? (\textbf{il vento}.) Fire? (\textbf{il fuoco}.) A dog? (\textbf{il cane}.) A cat? (\textbf{il gatto}.) A horse? (\textbf{il cavallo}.) A cow? (\textbf{la mucca}.) A pig? (\textbf{il maiale}.) A bird? (\textbf{l'uccello}.) A mouse? (\textbf{il topo}.) A wolf? (\textbf{il lupo}.) A bear? (\textbf{l'orso}.) A fox? (\textbf{la volpe}.) A snake? (\textbf{il serpente}.) A hen? (\textbf{la gallina}.) A duck? (\textbf{l'anatra}.) A sheep? (\textbf{la pecora}.) A goat? (\textbf{la capra}.) A lion? (\textbf{il leone}.) A monkey? (\textbf{la scimmia}.) A bee? (\textbf{l'ape}.) An ant? (\textbf{la formica}.) An elephant? (\textbf{l'elefante}.) Big? (\textbf{grande}.) Small? (\textbf{piccolo}.) New? (\textbf{nuovo}.) Old? (\textbf{vecchio}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{bello}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing, time, place and the town — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R84-second-pass-describing-time-place-and-the-town}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for ugly and long.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ugly, long, short, hot, cold
  \item fast, slow, easy, difficult, dear; expensive
  \item cheap, tall, short, full, empty
  \item strong, weak, rich, poor, yellow
  \item green, grey, clean, dirty, pleased
  \item a week, a month, a year, the morning, a minute
  \item always, never; ever, now, far, above
  \item under, inside, outside, a square, a street
  \item a city, a shop, a market, a school, a bank
  \item a station, a bus, a train, an aeroplane, a car
  \item a bridge, a park, a church, a museum, a restaurant
  \item a hotel, a pharmacy, the post office; the post, the police, a library
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ugly? (\textbf{brutto}.) Long? (\textbf{lungo}.) Short? (\textbf{corto}.) Hot? (\textbf{caldo}.) Cold? (\textbf{freddo}.) Fast? (\textbf{veloce}.) Slow? (\textbf{lento}.) Easy? (\textbf{facile}.) Difficult? (\textbf{difficile}.) Dear; expensive? (\textbf{caro}.) Cheap? (\textbf{economico}.) Tall? (\textbf{alto}.) Short? (\textbf{basso}.) Full? (\textbf{pieno}.) Empty? (\textbf{vuoto}.) Strong? (\textbf{forte}.) Weak? (\textbf{debole}.) Rich? (\textbf{ricco}.) Poor? (\textbf{povero}.) Yellow? (\textbf{giallo}.) Green? (\textbf{verde}.) Grey? (\textbf{grigio}.) Clean? (\textbf{pulito}.) Dirty? (\textbf{sporco}.) Pleased? (\textbf{contento}.) A week? (\textbf{la settimana}.) A month? (\textbf{il mese}.) A year? (\textbf{l'anno}.) The morning? (\textbf{la mattina}.) A minute? (\textbf{il minuto}.) Always? (\textbf{sempre}.) Never; ever? (\textbf{mai}.) Now? (\textbf{adesso}.) Far? (\textbf{lontano}.) Above? (\textbf{sopra}.) Under? (\textbf{sotto}.) Inside? (\textbf{dentro}.) Outside? (\textbf{fuori}.) A square? (\textbf{la piazza}.) A street? (\textbf{la strada}.) A city? (\textbf{la città}.) A shop? (\textbf{il negozio}.) A market? (\textbf{il mercato}.) A school? (\textbf{la scuola}.) A bank? (\textbf{la banca}.) A station? (\textbf{la stazione}.) A bus? (\textbf{l'autobus}.) A train? (\textbf{il treno}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{l'aereo}.) A car? (\textbf{la macchina}.) A bridge? (\textbf{il ponte}.) A park? (\textbf{il parco}.) A church? (\textbf{la chiesa}.) A museum? (\textbf{il museo}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{il ristorante}.) A hotel? (\textbf{l'albergo}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{la farmacia}.) The post office; the post? (\textbf{la posta}.) The police? (\textbf{la polizia}.) A library? (\textbf{la biblioteca}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
